notes: Executable vineyard-law constraints that are directly observable in VineyardBlock. Row-spacing and within-row-spacing limits are source-verified for both appellations but are not promoted here because VineyardBlock does not yet carry those physical measurements.

constraints.notes: Current Fixin specification requires at least 9,000 vines/ha and prohibits irrigation. It also requires row spacing <=1.25 m and within-row spacing >=0.50 m; those dimensions remain unexecuted until the block schema records them. The current specification states no special transitional measures.

The current INAO product record links the homologated Vougeot specification requiring at least 9,000 vines/ha and prohibiting irrigation. The specification also requires row spacing <=1.25 m and within-row spacing >=0.50 m. Its historical density transition expired before the simulation era represented here and is not generalized into a current exception.
